note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published in the kit starter (2026-11-18); every guide is written in our own words. Five hidden trophies have unconfirmed triggers and are marked unconfirmed — never invented.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically, so treat it as the finish line rather than a task of its own. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then the stranger strands and activities, and save the long grinds — 250 stunts, 100% completion — for last. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC, so a single offline playthrough can earn it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Unlock every other trophy; no multiplayer or DLC needed.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which the game tracks under Progress > Stats once the story is done. That checklist covers missions, stranger strands, activities, stunts, collectibles and challenges, so chip away at it across the whole playthrough instead of leaving it all to the end. The in-game stats screen is the authority on what is left; finish every category it lists and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish the 100% Completion checklist (appears after the story under Progress > Stats).

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to close out the main campaign. It unlocks naturally by playing the story to its end, so there is nothing special to prepare. If you are chasing the platinum, finish the story before starting the long completion grinds, since several activities only open up in later chapters.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts spread across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, Knife Flights and base jumps. Stunts are tracked as you find them, so try the marked jumps whenever you pass one rather than hunting them all at the end. Any mix of the four stunt types counts toward the 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights, base jumps.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Open WAiNK whenever you reach a new area and scan anything it highlights; the count builds up fast if you scan as you travel. You do not need every scannable spot in the game, just 100 of them.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets; there are 18 sets in total, so pick the easiest three. Cards are found across Leonida, and each set needs every card in it, so focus on one set at a time. Check your collection often so you know which sets are closest to done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (there are 18).

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges across the 12 Shooting Ranges. Each range hosts several challenges, so work through them one range at a time and repeat any challenge until the gold score lands. Steady aim and the right weapon for each challenge matter more than speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Gold in all 42 challenges across the 12 Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks questlines — the side characters marked across Leonida. Their strands unlock in different chapters, so keep returning to strangers you have met as the story advances. Eight completed strands is the requirement, and there are more than eight available.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks questlines.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and get away clean. Plan each robbery with an escape route in mind, because the trophy only counts when you escape after the robbery. You can pick any five of the eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and get away.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges the game tracks. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more, so most of the 50 will come naturally during a thorough playthrough. Check the Challenges list to see which ones are close and mop those up deliberately.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida; simply scanning a vehicle with WAiNK is enough to count it. Drive through new areas and scan anything unfamiliar, including parked cars. Traffic-heavy streets and car parks are the fastest way to build the count.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Discover 100 vehicles; a WAiNK scan is enough.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map by exploring every region. Drive, fly or sail into each unmapped area until no fog remains on the map screen. This pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies, so explore as you travel between missions.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida. One meditation — Lucia showing you on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — may be required and cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, so do it then. After that, visit the remaining spots at any point in the story; the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots. One meditation — Lucia showing you on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — may be required and cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, so do it then.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — crimes, heists and other illicit acts the game counts toward your profile. It builds up over a normal playthrough, so keep playing the way the game encourages and check your profile count as you go. Any action that moves the profile counts, so there is no single thing to grind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Sample each one as it unlocks and the trophy pops after the ninth. You only need to try them, not win or master them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Try all 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Learn each course's turns before racing for the win, and retry any location you lose until it is won. The trophy pops when all 14 locations have a win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Enter races across the map and take the win in 20 distinct ones; repeats of a race you already won do not add to the count. Mix race types to keep it fresh and bank wins as you travel.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Win 20 different races (out of 40).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest; his questline starts in Chapter 1. Follow Cal's strand until the contest is offered, then out-fish him to take the win. If you lose, you can retry the contest.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Beat Cal in a fishing contest; his questline starts in Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Beat any one of the 4 video games — three of them are on the TV at home. Pick the game you find easiest, learn its controls, and play until you beat it. One win is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Beat any one of the 4 video games (three are on the TV at home).

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together at the gym: while one works out, the other trains automatically, so keep both of their routines going. When both hit max Strength together, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together at the gym: while one works out, the other trains automatically.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5 quests; Lucia only, from Chapter 3. Play as Lucia and follow Andy's strand through all five quests. The strand only opens in Chapter 3, so it cannot be started earlier.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Finish Andy's 5 quests; Lucia only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear 7 shipwrecks for Kenton; the strand is available from Chapter 1. Dive each wreck site and clear it, working through all seven. Kenton's missions can be done alongside the early story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Clear 7 shipwrecks for Kenton; from Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub; the strand opens from Chapter 2. Ride out to the Mudclub and work through Billy's five quests in order. The final quest closes the strand and the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Finish Billy's 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub; from Chapter 2.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List; the strand opens from Chapter 3. Each car must be found and delivered in the condition Randy wants, so check the list before each delivery run. The trophy pops on the sixteenth delivery.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List; from Chapter 3.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest; Jason only, from Chapter 3. Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's strand to its final mission, taking out the labs along the way. The trophy pops when the last quest is complete.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest; Jason only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; Jason only. The exact animal is still being confirmed in the published lists, so this guide states only what is known and invents no trigger. Check Bret's strand in-game for the hunt it offers and take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; Jason only. The exact animal is still being confirmed.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level together with your partner. Build the wanted level with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and lose the heat. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the police lose track of you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Escape a 4-star wanted level together with your partner. Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well: hit one, move straight to the next, and do not lose the wanted level between them. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well; the trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store undetected; you need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3. Case the store, slip in without raising an alarm, and take the goods without being spotted. Getting seen at any point voids the attempt, so restart if the alarm goes up.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Rob a jewelry store undetected (needs the Snap Gun from Chapter 3).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Wait for a truck on its route, hit it, grab the cash and break away before the police close in. Any armored truck counts, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the attempt.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Rob an armored truck and get away.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs; 39 operations exist in total. Each gang needs just one of its operations hit, so target the easiest operation per gang. The trophy pops once all nine gangs have been hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs (39 exist).

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. Grab the three valuables inside the bowling alley, then break away and lose your wanted level. The trophy counts once you are clear of the heat with all three items.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences. Marked bills come from robberies, and fences will clean them for a cut, so keep feeding them bills until the total hits $250,000. It is a slow grind, so launder after every big score.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, clothes, cars or anything else; every dollar spent in a shop counts toward the total. Big purchases like vehicles move the counter fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Spend $100,000 across any shops.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. Each garage is a property you can buy from its sale sign, so save up and purchase them one by one. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 in total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you own or find can be registered through the app, so register each new ride as you get it. The tenth registration triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower first, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle against a group. Gang members at their illegal operations make a good target, since they cluster together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Buff focus with food, drinks or a shower first, bring Adrenaline, use an assault rifle, and pick gang members at their illegal operations.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a VCIA boarding bridge — terminals E3/E4 work — and fly 1 km away. Board the plane, get it moving, and put a kilometre between you and the airport. Airport security will chase you, so take off as fast as you can.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Steal an airliner docked at a VCIA boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4 work) and fly 1 km away.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station. Get inside the base, reach a Rhino tank, and drive it out. Expect heavy resistance on the way in and out, so bring armour and a fast getaway plan.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: PowerPyx trophy guide; GamesRadar+ trophy list
trophies.trigger: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published lists; no reliable method has been published yet, so this guide invents none. The description points to a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view, which is the only lead available.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: Have a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view; exact trigger still unknown.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published lists; no reliable method has been published yet, so this guide invents none. The description points to a showroom smash-out, which is the only lead available.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: Smash out of a car showroom; exact trigger still unknown.

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published lists; no reliable method has been published yet, so this guide invents none. Something that fails the first time and succeeds on the second is the only lead the description gives.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: The description hints at a second attempt; trigger still unknown.

trophies.guide: The description hints at something strange. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published lists; no reliable method has been published yet, so this guide invents none. An odd or out-of-place encounter somewhere in Leonida is the only lead the description gives.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: The description hints at something strange; trigger still unknown.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed in the published lists; no reliable method has been published yet, so this guide invents none. The description points to a drive-by with a melee weapon, which is the only lead available.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; trigger unconfirmed in published lists
trophies.trigger: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by; exact trigger still unknown.

trophies.guide: Finish the first story mission, Gone Fishing. It is the opening mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the story. There is nothing to prepare and nothing that can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish the first story mission (Gone Fishing).

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play through the opening chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Play through the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Play through the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Play through the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 2 story mission, Breakfast Run. Play the story until Breakfast Run is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 2 story mission (Breakfast Run).

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 3 story mission, The Cartel Heist. Play the story until The Cartel Heist is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 3 story mission (The Cartel Heist).

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission, Child's Play. Play the story until Child's Play is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission, Headliners. Play the story until Headliners is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission, VCIA Takedown. Play the story until VCIA Takedown is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.guide: Finish a Chapter 5 story mission, Operation Savage Glory. Play the story until Operation Savage Glory is offered and complete it. It is story-only, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official PlayStation trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide
trophies.trigger: Finish a Chapter 5 story mission.
